<thought>We need the number of chemically distinct hydrogen environments in the compound for task_18_subtask_5. The only way to obtain this information is to request the 1H NMR spectrum, which will list the distinct proton signals. The tool proton_nmr_spectra takes no arguments, so we’ll call it and then count the unique signals reported.</thought>
